summary.text: Don Scott is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 88, which covers part of the City of Portsmouth.
Don Scott has been a member since 2020 and is the Speaker of the House.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Don Scott was born in Houston, Texas.
Don Scott studied at Texas A&M University (Agricultural Education, 1987) and Louisiana State University (J.D., 1994).
Don Scott's listed occupation is attorney.
The profile says Don Scott served as an officer in the U.S. Navy from 1988 to 1991.

Don Scott's listed memberships and affiliations include Grace Episcopal Church, Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc., the boards of the Access College Foundation and Future of Hampton Roads, and the Portsmouth Economic Development Authority (chairman).
The profile lists Mellanda Yvonne Colson-Scott as Don Scott's spouse.
The House profile lists Don Scott's committee assignments as Rules (Chair).
